avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer reduces nelfinavir plasma concentrations by up to 50%, reducing antiretroviral efficacy and increasing resistance risk
avoid_supplements.action: Absolutely contraindicated; counsel patient to avoid completely and report use immediately

avoid_supplements.name: Garlic supplements (high-dose)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction reduces nelfinavir bioavailability and therapeutic levels
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid high-dose garlic supplements; monitor viral load if patient insists on use

avoid_supplements.name: Rifabutin
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Strong CYP3A4 inducer significantly decreases nelfinavir concentrations below therapeutic range
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; use alternative antimycobacterial agent if TB treatment needed

caution_supplements.name: Echinacea
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential mild CYP3A4 induction may modestly reduce nelfinavir levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor viral load; use sparingly and inform healthcare provider

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have minor CYP3A4 inducing properties affecting drug metabolism
caution_supplements.action: Use cautiously; maintain consistent dosing if used

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor increases nelfinavir plasma concentrations, elevating risk of toxicity and QT prolongation
avoid_foods.action: Completely avoid grapefruit products; counsel on dietary restriction

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May enhance nelfinavir absorption and bioavailability; absorption is food-dependent
caution_foods.action: Administer with food as directed; consistent meal timing optimizes levels

caution_foods.name: Alcohol (heavy use)
caution_foods.mechanism: May impair hepatic metabolism and increase GI side effects; nelfinavir is hepatically metabolized
caution_foods.action: Counsel to limit alcohol; monitor liver function if chronic use

monitoring_notes: Nelfinavir requires administration with food for optimal absorption. Baseline and periodic viral load/CD4 monitoring is essential to detect subtherapeutic levels from drug-supplement interactions. Counsel patients on strict avoidance of potent CYP3A4 inducers and grapefruit to maintain antiretroviral efficacy.
